ranked.headline: Computational methods resolve heterogeneity in single-cell and bulk genomic data
ranked.summary: Recent work applies statistical and machine learning models to single-cell and bulk genomic data, resolving heterogeneity across tumors and tissues.

ranked.headline: Algorithms resolve genome structure, lineage and haplotypes from sequencing data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications introduce error-aware distances, pangenome genotyping and haplotype phasing for sequence data.

ranked.headline: Graph and optimal-transport methods integrate incomplete spatial multi-omics data
ranked.summary: Multiple preprints and two published methods target imputation, cross-platform integration, and rare-population discovery in spatial and single-cell omics.

ranked.headline: Chromatin and single-cell multiomics are used to infer regulatory programs
ranked.summary: New deep learning and Bayesian frameworks decode enhancer, trans-eQTL and promoter regulation from single-cell and chromatin data.

ranked.headline: Pretrained biological language models repurposed for variant and structure tasks
ranked.summary: Evolutionary and structural information is now built into pooling, tokenization, and pretraining targets for biomolecular language models.

ranked.headline: Deep models map sequence and chromatin context onto gene regulation and expression
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend sequence-based deep models to single-cell perturbation response, splicing, RNA editing, and ribosome positioning.

ranked.headline: Generative models now target protein dynamics, antibody design, and mutational stability
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and one publication couple generative sampling and protein language models to dynamics, antibody design, and stability prediction.

ranked.headline: Transposable elements and rearrangements reshape genomes across species and lineages
ranked.summary: Reference-free pangenome analysis and reanalysis of existing shallow sequencing data now detect structural and insertional genome change directly.

ranked.headline: Learned representations drive generative design of molecules, proteins, and macrocycles
ranked.summary: Learned latent and embedding spaces now condition synthesizable, macrocyclic, protein, and phenotype-conditioned generation across recent preprints.

ranked.headline: Learned representations integrate unpaired, missing, and spatial omics modalities
ranked.summary: Deep models now impute missing modalities, align unpaired cytometry and omics data, and link histology to transcriptomic molecular subtypes.

ranked.headline: LLM agents add explicit reasoning to perturbation prediction and molecule optimization
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published agent report LLM frameworks that couple retrieval, prediction, and iterative reasoning to perturbation and drug design tasks.

ranked.headline: Network models link regulatory structure to threshold and transition dynamics in cells
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply network and dynamical models to bud dormancy, metabolic homeostasis, and single-cell fate transitions.

ranked.headline: Computational models infer cell state and lineage from single-cell and spatial profiles
ranked.summary: Growing single-cell and spatial resources now pair with deep learning and optimal transport to nominate lineage, state, and intervention targets.

ranked.headline: Learned models predict protein-ligand binding affinity and poses with greater efficiency
ranked.summary: Coarse pocket representations, geometric scoring, and transfer-based hybrids are being benchmarked on CASF-2016 and related binding datasets.

ranked.headline: Graph-structured models scale biomedical learning across single-cell, histology, EHR
ranked.summary: Linear-complexity graph and state-space architectures now handle large-scale single-cell and whole-slide data without sacrificing relational structure.

ranked.headline: Standardized evaluation of biomolecular structure, sequence, and property prediction
ranked.summary: Open benchmarks and models now test biomolecular predictors under standardized evaluation across structure, sequence, and property tasks.

ranked.headline: Phylogenetic and genotyping tools extend to networks, single cells, and viral mixtures
ranked.summary: Early February 2026 releases address stable graph representation, network estimation, and error-tolerant genotyping and phylogenetics on noisy or sparse data.

ranked.headline: Language models for proteins, RNA, and molecules adopt grammar and mechanistic constraints
ranked.summary: Sequence-based language models for antibodies, proteins, RNA, and molecules now target specific functional prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Long-read and graph-based tools extend automated microbial genome and plasmid analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications describe automated long-read workflows and benchmarks for microbial genome, plasmid, and resistance-gene analysis.

ranked.headline: Cross-taxa genomic comparisons link conserved features to habitat and host adaptation
ranked.summary: Collections now spanning over 3,000 genomes and 2,138 deep-sea samples enable direct cross-taxa comparison of functional and regulatory features.

ranked.headline: Single-cell metabolomics and senescence profiling expand multiomic cell-state resolution
ranked.summary: Single-cell metabolomics at about 800 metabolites per cell and multiomic senescence resources now enable deeper cell-state characterization.

ranked.headline: Inferring identifiable causal and dynamical models from time-series data across domains
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair causal identifiability and ground-truth benchmarks with dynamical-systems measures to validate inferred models.

ranked.headline: Single-cell and nanopore methods map crossovers and telomere-proximal genome structure
ranked.summary: Single-cell and long-read sequencing now resolve meiotic and mitotic crossovers and telomere structure with open computational tools.

ranked.headline: Models link immune modulation and antibody design to structure and cell states
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication pair mechanistic, structural and simulation-based modelling with ML to predict immune and mRNA delivery outcomes.

ranked.headline: Machine learning and kinetic models guide nucleic acid design and synthesis
ranked.summary: Machine learning and mechanistic models are now applied to predict and optimize RNA sensors, primers, and transcription yield from sequence and process inputs.

ranked.headline: Harmonized FAIR metadata layers make public omics data findable and reusable across…
ranked.summary: Heterogeneous omics annotations across public archives are prompting harmonized, FAIR-aligned metadata resources and interfaces for cross-study reuse.

ranked.headline: Somatic STR mutations and CNV phenotypes reveal non-SNV genome variation
ranked.summary: Single-cell, biobank-scale and chromatin atlas datasets now resolve mosaic repeat mutations, copy number phenotypes and regulatory states together.

ranked.headline: New tools resolve polyploid alleles, centromeres and chromatin from sequence data
ranked.summary: Long-read and pangenome assemblies now enable allele-, isoform- and region-resolved regulatory and structural analysis across polyploid and fungal genomes.

ranked.headline: Electric fields can override durotaxis; stochastic models extend to glioma invasion
ranked.summary: Predictive biophysical and multiscale tumor models are being released as open platforms and simulators to test directed motion.

ranked.headline: Resting-state fMRI modeling links brain dynamics to behavior and psychopathology
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair deep state space and causal models with open epilepsy connectome data, shifting resting-state fMRI toward clinical prediction.

ranked.headline: Methylation and RNA models quantify biological age and link it to clinical biomarkers
ranked.summary: Sex-specific nonlinear methylation trajectories and Methylation Screening Array predictors extend aging models toward cancer risk and clinical biomarkers.

ranked.headline: Geometric descriptors and learned models curate cryo-EM and cryo-ET particle data
ranked.summary: Large motif datasets and automated particle filters now pair machine learning with explicit geometric descriptors of cryo-EM and cryo-ET data.

ranked.headline: Learned potentials and diffusion models advance atomistic design of molecular binding
ranked.summary: Recent work tests atom-level diffusion design, hybrid ML/MM potentials for charged ligands, and coarse-graining choices for equivariant ML potentials.

ranked.headline: Polymer models link homolog pairing and chromatin contacts to 3D genome folding
ranked.summary: Polymer and supercoiling simulations built on Hi-C, MNase positioning and genome architecture now predict chromatin organization at high resolution.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic evolutionary models tested against neural and alternative inference methods
ranked.summary: Recent preprints compare mechanistic evolution models against neural and population-genetic alternatives across protein, alignment, and pangenome data.

ranked.headline: Simulations resolve transient states governing condensate flux and redox steering
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication apply residue-level simulation to short-lived states that direct transport in condensates and supercomplexes.

ranked.headline: Software tools for detecting and annotating RNA viruses in sequence data
ranked.summary: Recent preprint and publications describe unified pipelines combining viral detection, taxonomic assignment, and domain annotation for sequence assemblies.

ranked.headline: In silico pathogenicity prediction for missense and synonymous human variants
ranked.summary: Computational variant prioritization is extending from structure-resolved missense sites to synonymous variation in disease genes.

ranked.headline: Computational inference from MS/MS spectra links unknowns to structures and conjugates
ranked.summary: Reverse search over 1.32 billion public MS/MS spectra and new similarity models extend metabolite annotation to unknown structures and conjugates.

ranked.headline: Software places PTM sites, coevolving residues and Mg2+ ions in sequence or structure
ranked.summary: Recent releases couple residue-level annotation with evolutionary or structural context, offering Python and Coot-integrated tooling for expert analysis.
